audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds by design. Engine API does not transmit blob sidecar data (blobs, commitments, proofs); only blob_versioned_hashes are sent. ValidateParams verifies hash consistency between Engine API parameter and transaction fields. Actual KZG proof verification occurs in MempoolBlobTxValidator.ValidateProofs (L289) for P2P-gossiped blob transactions, which is the correct trust boundary where blobs enter the EL.
